scope: All68 exact GPL words entering the Planar_EW1 singular boundary at s=-x^2/10,t=-x^2/25,b=-x^2/50. No improved physical form-factor accuracy or reusable regular-anchor claim yet.

method.native_boundary: Existing generalized Frobenius basis at0; regularized constant coefficient0 for every nonempty word and1 for empty word. Matching offsets1/32 and1/40.

method.endpoint: Existing Frobenius basis at z=1-t, matched to native values at1-offset. Extract the constant first component, after asserting exact absence of log powers in that component and zero exponents in every column. First GPL letter is never1; divergent suffix components are retained for matching.
method.original_comparison: Unchanged pinned DiffExp GEvaluate notebook helper at exact t=31/32. All68 native matching values are compared, without moving an endpoint by an arbitrary small number. Native endpoint values undergo independent precision/order/matching-radius variation.
method.precision: All scientific inputs rational or MPFR. Working digits are not treated as verified digits. Original component Precision/Accuracy metadata and reported error estimates are retained.
